title: All right
text: All right. These were all right. They just seemed a little more fake to me, as compared to some other ones I have recently got. I liked the purple one and put that one out, but the others were not as good for me. They are fine, they just look a little more artificial than some others. They did come in ok condition. It was nice to get four of them.
